result.brief: 提出 FAVOR 框架，利用世界动作模型预测的未来帧作为锚点进行验证与在线恢复，提升机器人操作任务成功率。
result.reason: World action model for robotic manipulation with predicted future frames as anchors; verification and recovery framework. Main contribution is policy execution monitoring, but built on world action model future prediction.
